# Underwriting Memo: Dalmora Grill Holdings

**Risk summary**

Dalmora Grill Holdings operates family restaurants with on-site kitchens and catering services across three Florida locations. The account presents $6.4M total TIV under governing class REST (Restaurant). All three locations are coastal: two in Miami (10.7 km and 12.7 km from coast) and one in Naples (1.5 km from coast). The broker is Marlowick Agency (Emerging tier) with a fit score of 53.5.

**Appetite and referral**

This account requires referral per **AG-013** due to three locations within 16 km of the coast and significant coastal accumulation concerns. Existing portfolio TIV within 25 km is $279.8M (Miami locations) and $200.5M (Naples location), both exceeding the $25M accumulation threshold. While REST class is target appetite per **AG-001**, the coastal exposure triggers mandatory referral.

**Loss history**

Five-year loss history shows 6 claims totaling $221,300 incurred. Notable claims include a $110,100 vehicle-into-storefront (2021), $55,800 water damage (2023), and $55,400 kitchen fire (2024). Two of the last three years show no claims.

**Exposure and concentration**

All locations are coastal with Naples presenting highest concern at 1.5 km from coast. Portfolio accumulation significantly exceeds **AG-013** thresholds in both Miami and Naples zones.

**Recommendation**

Suggest declining due to coastal accumulation concerns and moderate loss frequency, or quote with substantial wind/hail sublimits and coastal deductibles if strategic appetite exists.
